limits: No release promotion or universal correctness claim. Token parity is the retained final transcript, not every task or sampling policy.
Cold section timing summarizes three resident requests after a cold model opening; coldOpening uses the actual first request separately.
Doppler full browser/process opening is unavailable; reported opening starts at model initialization.
Two independent cold openings per model and GPU, one per engine order; OS/driver caches not purged.
Different optimized formats: Doppler Q4_K/F32 compute/F16 KV versus ONNX q4f16.
No cross-engine dedicated GPU residency claim: reported memory surfaces differ.
Hosts were not exclusive. Browser versions differ between GPUs; comparisons are within each hardware lane.
